detail.title: Initial Inquiry into Neurodiversity Paradigm
detail.summary: This cycle initiates a new research project on the neurodiversity paradigm. As my focus is on the structural distinctions between clinical pathology models and the neurodiversity framework, I am beginning by scoping the foundational literature. The goal is to articulate how these models define 'dysfunction' versus 'divergence' without conflating clinical utility with ontological status.
